import pytest

if getattr(pytest, "use_correct", False):
    from correct_python_programs.find_first_in_sorted import find_first_in_sorted
else:
    from python_programs.find_first_in_sorted import find_first_in_sorted


def test_attack_1_empty_array():
    assert find_first_in_sorted([], 5) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([], 0) == -1


def test_attack_2_single_element():
    assert find_first_in_sorted([42], 42) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted([42], 0) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([42], 99) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([-5], -5) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted([-5], -6) == -1


def test_attack_3_first_occurrence_middle_duplicates():
    # Example from docstring
    assert find_first_in_sorted([3, 4, 5, 5, 5, 5, 6], 5) == 2
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2, 2, 2, 3], 2) == 1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3, 4], 2) == 2


def test_attack_4_leading_duplicates():
    assert find_first_in_sorted([2, 2, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted([5, 5, 6, 7], 5) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 1, 1, 2, 3], 1) == 0


def test_attack_5_trailing_duplicates_and_all_equal():
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2, 3, 3, 3], 3) == 2
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4], 4) == 3
    assert find_first_in_sorted([7, 7, 7, 7, 7], 7) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted([7, 7, 7, 7, 7], 8) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([7, 7, 7, 7, 7], 6) == -1


def test_attack_6_not_present_below_above_gap():
    assert find_first_in_sorted([10, 20, 30], 5) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([10, 20, 30], 40) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 3, 5, 7], 4) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 3, 5, 7], 0) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 3, 5, 7], 8) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([-10, -5, 0, 5], -7) == -1


def test_attack_7_two_elements_and_boundaries():
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2], 1) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2], 2) == 1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2], 0) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2], 3) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 3], 2) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2, 3], 1) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2, 3], 3) == 2
    assert find_first_in_sorted([1, 2, 3], 2) == 1


def test_attack_8_large_array_with_duplicates():
    arr = list(range(0, 200, 2))
    assert find_first_in_sorted(arr, 100) == 50
    assert find_first_in_sorted(arr, 0) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted(arr, 198) == 99
    assert find_first_in_sorted(arr, 101) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted(arr, -2) == -1
    assert find_first_in_sorted(arr, 200) == -1
    big = [1] * 500 + [2] * 500
    assert find_first_in_sorted(big, 1) == 0
    assert find_first_in_sorted(big, 2) == 500
    assert find_first_in_sorted(big, 3) == -1
